declarations.name: MethbokeAddon.R3Ehrenfest.SmoothRepresentative.ComplexL1
declarations.scope: Finite frequency-ball support constructs the L1 Fourier data and every polynomial L1 moment for each sharp cutoff. The resulting actual smooth real representative is a bounded linear map and agrees almost everywhere with the native cutoff. A finite nonsharp fixed-cutoff L2-to-L-infinity bound is proved from explicit operator and indicator norms. No uniformity in the cutoff, geometric sharp constant, nonlinear flow or derivative-representative coherence is asserted.
